def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = torch.select_scatter(t0, t2.select(0, 6), 0, 6)
    t0.copy_(t2)
    v2 = torch.select_scatter(t2, v1.select(0, 1), 0, 1)
    v3 = torch.maximum(t2, v1)
    idx4 = torch.tensor([6, 22], device=v3.device)
    v3[idx4] += -5
    return (v2, v2, t1, v1, lst, dct)
